- [ ] (Outside contributors) I have read and agree to the SculptForge Contributor Licence Agreement ([docs/CLA.md](https://github.com/islandmed/SculptForge/blob/main/docs/CLA.md))

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), certifying the [DCO](https://developercertificate.org): my own work or properly licensed, not copied or derived from proprietary software, SDKs, decompiled code, documentation or assets
- [ ] A note in `changes/<branch>.md` (and the docs) if users will notice the change
- [ ] Touches CI, the build, dependencies, file readers, or network/plugin/scripting code? Say why below: these get a security review (CONTRIBUTING.md)
